subject: Edge region degradation — immediate reroute instructions and follow-up
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: ops@bluewaveanalytics.com, Samira Khan <samira.khan@bluewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Degraded responses from EU edge — immediate reroute guidance

Hi Samira / BlueWave ops team,

We’re seeing a targeted degradation affecting Redwood’s EU edge cluster (eu-west-1 region) that is increasing tail latency and causing intermittent 5xx on a subset of request paths for the last ~30 minutes. We wanted to reach out proactively — this affects in-region inference traffic but not Dedicated pools you may have reserved.

Immediate recommended action for BlueWave:
- Toggle your routing to the fallback region (us-central-1) via the traffic steering rule you configured in the dashboard. Steps are in the attached checklist.
- If you prefer automated failover, enable the pre-configured region-fallback policy (Profile: bw-automated-failover) — we can enable this for you if you want us to.
- For mission-critical low-latency paths, switch to your Dedicated capacity if available — see note below.

What we’re doing:
- Our infra team is isolating a device-level networking fault in the eu-west edge cluster and applying mitigations now.
- We’ve queued a rolling micro-restart of affected sidecars and are enabling stricter health checks to avoid noisy neighbors.
- More telemetry and a short incident log are attached.

If you want us to apply the failover on your behalf, reply with CONFIRM and the target region (us-central-1 or apac-south-1). We’ll execute and confirm back within 10 minutes.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you updated on progress and a preliminary post-incident note within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: incident-log-20290801.txt (text/plain), customer-reroute-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

> Marcus — thanks for the heads up.
>
> CONFIRM: please failover our bw-production route to us-central-1. Our in-house maintenance window is still open and us-central has capacity.

Thanks — executing now.

Operational notes for your team:
- Failover will maintain identical model versions. You may see a median latency increase of ~25–40ms due to cross-region RTT; heavy requests (long context) may see a slightly larger delta.
- There is no model behavior change; tokenization and model weights are identical. Unit cost per token remains the same for hosted models; however, cross-region egress and networking may slightly increase overall request cost on your side. We’ll attach a short cost delta estimate after the switch.
- We will enable a temporary cache-warmup to reduce cold-starts for frequent prompts — expect improved p95 after ~5 minutes.

Confirmation: Completed at 09:29 PDT. I’ve left the session pinned to your account and will monitor metrics for 30 minutes.

Attachment: postmortem-draft-v1.md (text/markdown) — we’ll iterate this with ops and CLM.

Marcus Lin

Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@bluewaveanalytics.com, Samira Khan <samira.khan@bluewave.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Draft post-incident summary and action items (BlueWave)

Team / BlueWave,

Thanks everyone for the rapid coordination. Below is a short, customer-facing post-incident summary we’ll publish to BlueWave and add to the incident ticket. Please reply with edits; we’ll finalize and send from Marcus’ mailbox.

Short summary:
- Incident window: 2029-08-01 08:40 UTC to ongoing mitigation (initial fix applied 2029-08-01 09:45 UTC).
- Impact: partial degradation of EU edge cluster caused elevated latency and intermittent 5xx for roughly 35 minutes for hosted inference traffic originating in eu-west-1. Dedicated capacity remained available and unaffected.
- Root cause (prelim): a misconfigured forwarding rule in an edge network device combined with an overloaded neighbor process that caused request amplification on a small subset of servers.

Customer-facing actions completed:
- BlueWave traffic for bw-production routed to us-central-1 at customer request (completed 09:29 PDT).
- Cache warmup and throttling adjustments applied to reduce tail latency.
- Telemetry collection and full logs attached.

Post-incident action items (owners):
1) Network rule validation sweep across eu-west clusters (owner: Olga) — complete by 2029-08-05.
2) Harden sidecar health checks and backpressure gating (owner: Lauren) — rollout 2029-08-07.
3) Customer communication & billing note: confirm no credits are required; provide cost delta estimate (owner: Marcus) — by 2029-08-03.
4) Update status page and attach final postmortem (owner: Ben) — by 2029-08-04.

Samira / BlueWave: let us know if you want additional telemetry slices or a dedicated postmortem call. We’ll correlate logs and finalize the root cause analysis in the next 48–72 hours.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: incident-log-20290801.txt, postmortem-draft-v1.md
